principles: Use familiar controls and a single active replay cursor as the signature interaction.
Keep model provenance and limitations visible at the point of use.
Favor rules, density, and type hierarchy over decorative surfaces.

typography.family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

responsive_patterns.desktop: 15.75rem sticky navy identity rail with a max-width evidence field
responsive_patterns.tablet: identity rail becomes top navigation at 850px
responsive_patterns.mobile: two-column replay controls and two-column event record at 540px

interaction_patterns: CSV replay position is driven only by recorded sample timestamps.
Actual traces use solid color; setpoints use dashed navy.
Orange identifies the current replay sample and active event.
A failed file load clears stale charts, live values, records, and enabled controls.
accessibility: Visible focus treatment includes the hidden file input's parent label.
Interactive controls meet a 44px minimum height on touch layouts.
Canvas summaries are available as semantic table data.
anti_patterns: Do not add gradients, glass panels, generic KPI cards, or decorative 3D cockpit chrome.
Do not imply validation, live operation, or aircraft fidelity from replay UI.
Do not use color as the sole indicator of state.
